name: Vomiting
overview: Vomiting is a health topic that clinicians and patients frequently discuss during care planning in India and worldwide. Key considerations include expulsion of stomach contents via the mouth or nose. This summary is educational and should be paired with professional medical evaluation.
possibleCauses: Health professionals note that vomiting is the forceful expulsion of the contents of one's stomach through the mouth and sometimes the nose.
In routine practice, the vomited contents are known as vomit or vomitus.
